characters.name: Ariel
characters.description: Boy about 5, small and round-faced, light olive skin, short straight black hair, big gentle dark-brown eyes, small sky-blue knitted kippah, red-and-white striped T-shirt, blue shorts, green rubber garden boots; signature item: the green garden boots.

characters.name: Savta
characters.description: Ariel's grandmother, about 65, soft and round, light olive skin, kind crinkly grey-blue eyes, reading glasses on a beaded chain, silver hair fully tucked under a lilac headscarf, long-sleeved lavender blouse and long grey skirt, a gardening apron; signature item: the beaded glasses chain.

characters.name: Mother bird
characters.description: A small brown songbird like a house sparrow, warm brown and cream feathers, a pale chest, bright black bead eyes, sitting on a round nest of twigs and grass with three tiny pale-blue eggs.

characters.name: Ox
characters.description: A large gentle brown ox with short curved horns, soft brown eyes, a wooden yoke on its neck, shown only inside Savta's story visions in an ancient field.

characters.name: Donkey
characters.description: A small grey donkey with long ears, a white muzzle and dark eyes, carrying two heavy cloth sacks tied across its back, shown only inside Savta's story visions.

cover.prompt: In a lush Israeli home garden, Ariel kneels beside a big green bush, gently holding a leaf aside to peek at a round nest where the brown mother bird sits on three pale-blue eggs. Savta crouches beside him with a finger to her lips and a warm smile. Morning sunlight through the leaves, soft greens and blues, tender and quiet.

pages.prompt: Savta's sunny garden behind a small house with Jerusalem-stone walls and a mezuzah on the door. Ariel in his green boots plays with a toy truck on the path, then turns his head sharply toward a large bush, ear cocked, hearing a chirp. Savta waters flowers in the background. Wide shot, bright morning.

Close-up inside the bush: Ariel's small hand slowly moves a leaf aside, revealing a round twig nest with the brown mother bird sitting in it and three tiny pale-blue eggs peeking from underneath her. Ariel's wide amazed eyes visible through the leaves. Dappled green light, intimate framing.

The mother bird flutters her wings on the nest, looking straight at Ariel, protecting her eggs. Ariel draws back a little, whispering, hand over his mouth. Savta, kneeling beside him, gently explains with a soft hand on his back. Medium shot, gentle tension, soft garden light.

Savta sits down on the grass next to Ariel, close and warm, explaining kindly with an open hand toward the nest. Ariel looks up at her with a hopeful questioning face. The nest is visible in the bush beside them. Low camera at child height, calm golden light.

Ariel carefully puts the leaf back in place over the nest, his face thoughtful and tender, as if thinking of his own mother. Savta watches him with loving pride. Through a gap in the leaves the mother bird settles calmly on her eggs. Close-medium shot, soft warm tones.

Ariel and Savta sit together on a garden bench. Above them, in a soft dreamy watercolor vision, an ancient golden threshing floor where the gentle ox walks in slow circles over wheat stalks under a bright sky, a farmer in a simple robe beside it. Ariel looks up at the vision, fascinated. Pale dream colors above, warm garden below.

Inside Savta's story vision: the ox, with its mouth free, happily munches a mouthful of golden wheat while working on the threshing floor. Below, on the garden bench, Ariel listens with a sympathetic face, hand on his own tummy. Warm, kind mood, soft golden light.

Savta's story vision: on a dusty ancient road, the small grey donkey has sat down under two heavy sacks. A traveler kneels beside it, gently lifting the sacks off its back and helping it up, while another passer-by hurries over to help. The donkey looks relieved, not hurt. In the corner, Savta and Ariel watching from the bench.

Ariel jumps up from the bench with arms outstretched and a determined, eager face, ready to help. Savta smiles at him tenderly, her hand on her heart. Bright garden behind them, flowers in bloom. Medium shot, warm and proud mood.

Evening in the garden with a soft pink-orange sky. Ariel kneels carefully and places a small shallow bowl of water on the ground near the bush, watching seriously. The kitchen window glows warm behind him, Savta visible in the doorway. Calm, gentle, low camera angle.

Some days later: in the nest, three tiny fluffy chicks open their beaks wide, the mother bird perched beside them with a worm. At a respectful distance, Ariel in his green boots claps his hands softly with joy, Savta beside him smiling. Morning light, split focus from nest in foreground to Ariel behind.

A sunny neighborhood courtyard: Ariel kneels to put a small bowl of water down for a thirsty ginger cat, while a sparrow watches from a windowsill and a neighbor's friendly dog wags its tail nearby. Savta waves from the balcony. Bright, warm, inviting the reader to care for animals.
